This vignette shows how to normalize Portuguese text with `portuNLP`.

```{r}
library(portuNLP)
normalize_text("Ação e emoção", correct = TRUE)
```

You can also remove punctuation and apply custom dictionaries if needed.

```{r}
normalize_text("Olá, Mundo!", remove_punct = TRUE)
```

After normalizing text you may want to tokenize the results. Tokenization
facilitates later steps such as lemmatization and part-of-speech tagging.

```{r}
tokens <- tokenize_pt("Gosto de R e Python.")
lemmatize_pt(unlist(tokens))
pos_tag_pt(unlist(tokens), universal = TRUE)
```
